item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khros ma'i man ngag gab pa'i gsang mdzod chen mo
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro mas snyigs ma'i kho bo bdag la snyan du brgyud bzhin/ phyi rabs rjes 'brang rnams kyis gong gi mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin legs par zab bo/ gcig brgyud kho bo bdag gi dam cha yin pas sa ma ya huM rgya rgya rgya snyigs ma'i kho bo badz+ra b+ho d+hi badz+ra drung mu wer ya'i mtshan gyis gsang ba'i gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug mngon dga' shel dkar rtse ru legs par bkod pa mu tsug smar ro//
